title: Four Clues on Rua das Acacias

scenes.title: Vinte passos a leste (Twenty Paces East)
scenes.summary: Outside the courtyard gate on Rua das Acacias, Camila, Otávio, and Rafael check the brass compass and count twenty paces east toward the stone fountain.

scenes.title: Perto do chafariz de pedra (By the Stone Fountain)
scenes.summary: At the neighbourhood stone fountain, Camila and Rafael spot a carved leaf pointing toward the clock tower, but Otávio insists on taking a back-lane shortcut.

scenes.title: O famoso atalho (The Famous Shortcut)
scenes.summary: After three confident left turns, Otávio leads the group straight back outside Bianca's open café kitchen window at Cashew Tree Guesthouse.

scenes.title: A sombra da torre do relógio (Shadow of the Clock Tower)
scenes.summary: Joined by Tiago at the municipal clock tower at noon, Camila and Rafael watch the tower shadow point straight to a carved compass stone.

scenes.title: Debaixo do arco do sebo (Under the Bookshop Arch)
scenes.summary: Meeting Helena under the stone arch of the second-hand bookshop, Camila spots the green lending shelf in Card Three—making Helena gasp as she remembers the botanical book in Room 4.

scenes.title: O banco sombreado da praça (The Shaded Park Bench)
scenes.summary: At the shaded public garden bench at the end of Rua das Acacias, Rafael places all four square cards together to reveal a bird's-eye map of Cashew Tree Guesthouse with a red star on the upper balcony.

scenes.title: Abrindo o envelope pequeno (Opening the Small Envelope)
scenes.summary: On the park bench, Camila, Helena, and Rafael break the wax seal and read the mapmaker's promise to return for Saturday tea thirty summers later.

scenes.title: Recado na recepção (Message at the Front Desk)
scenes.summary: Returning briskly to the front desk, Camila and Otávio find Jorge holding an express station message announcing the retired mapmaker arrives next Saturday evening.
